first.rationale: I currently intend to test simplified onboarding because completion is down 4% and the inherited evidence indicates that shorter onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, and early adoption. This is more likely to support sustainable qualified revenue than immediately discounting, while potentially addressing the activation decline. I will verify the onboarding and activation records before committing, and will monitor downstream qualified revenue and account quality rather than optimizing completion alone.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding, since completion is down 4% and the verified source shows a durable improvement in completion (+13%), time-to-value (-2.1 days), and 30-day retention (+3%). This offers stronger evidence for sustainable qualified revenue than promotional pricing and addresses the onboarding issue directly. Track activation, qualified pipeline/revenue, time-to-value, retention, and account quality—not completion alone—to detect downstream harm. Activation messaging is also validated, but its smaller retention lift (+1%) makes onboarding the higher-leverage single experiment this week.
